name: io.github.RidioDevelopment/socialcrawl
title: SocialCrawl
description: Access 42 platforms and 264 endpoints through one unified API — social media, commerce & product reviews (Amazon, Google Shopping), app stores (Google Play, App Store), places & travel (Tripadvisor, Google Business/Hotels), business reputation (Trustpilot), web research (Tavily, Perplexity), Naver, content/sentiment analysis, Google News & Finance, GitHub, Hacker News, Polymarket, AI X-search via Grok, cross-platform Prism composites (lookup, comments, reputation, share-of-voice, AI consensus, and more), plus a universal /search/everywhere meta-search.
